description: A .url whose [InternetShortcut.A] URL= holds Windows-1252 bytes, so the file is not UTF-8
notes: parse() refuses the WHOLE file with InvalidUtf8 at the first high byte, not just that one value - which is why the codepage feature transcodes in front of the parser rather than adding a decoding accessor. The [InternetShortcut] URL= is the percent-encoded form of the same URL and is pure ASCII, so it survives transcoding byte for byte: every code page in rclip-codepage is ASCII-transparent.
